plants.name: Sal Tree
plants.summary: A dominant canopy tree in Indian deciduous forests, valued for timber and resin. Its dense canopy is a key indicator of healthy forest cover.

plants.name: Teak
plants.summary: A large deciduous tree prized for durable timber; often used as a bioindicator species when mapping deforestation in tropical regions.

animals.name: Bengal Tiger
animals.summary: An apex predator whose habitat range is a strong proxy for forest health; tiger corridors are frequently used to prioritize conservation zones.

animals.name: Indian Elephant
animals.summary: A keystone species that shapes forest structure through seed dispersal and vegetation clearing; highly sensitive to canopy fragmentation.

terrain.name: Western Ghats
terrain.summary: A UNESCO World Heritage mountain range and biodiversity hotspot, home to dense evergreen forest and thousands of endemic species.

terrain.name: Ganges River
terrain.summary: One of the major river systems of South Asia, supporting extensive floodplain forest and wetland ecosystems along its basin.
